summary: Obsidian Energy, a Canadian oil and gas issuer listed on TSX/NYSE American, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 results via news release, MD&A and interim financial statements. Highlights include production of 28,113 boe/d, funds flow of $86.7 million (adjusted $80.7 million), net income of $18.0 million, capital spending of $75.6 million and net debt of $363.3 million. The company repurchased and cancelled 0.9 million shares for $13.0 million at an average of $15.08 under its normal course issuer bid. No transactional special situation is disclosed; the filing is a routine quarterly earnings report.
